_comment: Full E10.2 continuation after audited both-model first100 pilot. Exact originalbinary/models/pools; hash-verified prefix reused without manifest editing; only f883healthrepair; all original candidate/parity/speed gates unchanged.

jobs.name: e10_self_full_v3
cmd: set -eu; out="$1"; mkdir -p "$out"; for f in ember.tgz tinyllama_server self_output_pool.py self_output_gate.py self_output_vm.sh pilot_prefix.tgz pick.gguf pk.gguf eval100.jsonl pick_pool.jsonl pk_pool.jsonl pick_table.bin pk_table.bin COMMITS INPUT_SHA256SUMS; do cp "/content/chat/upload/$f" "/content/$f"; done; rc=0; bash /content/self_output_vm.sh || rc=$?; cp /content/vm.log "$out/vm.log"; if [ -s /content/out.zip ]; then cp /content/out.zip "$out/out.zip"; fi; if [ -s /content/out/gate_summary.json ]; then cp /content/out/gate_summary.json "$out/gate_summary.json"; fi; exit "$rc"
